svg.title: Filters before the search
svg.desc: Search 3 of the Dark Knight example: maximize Direct Hit with Critical Hit at least 2,159 and Determination at least 1,277 in gear points, speed 1,035 to 1,092. The candidate lists hold 11,045 pieces with their meld versions. The shortfall filter, which fixes pieces short of their slot's best by more than the budget (5 points of Critical Hit), leaves 137; pruning against the set in hand from search 2 (reduced-cost fixing with a Lagrangian bound) leaves 120. The shortfall filter repeats after each fixing, until nothing more is dropped. Pareto fronts then settle the search: the largest front holds 6,958 partial sets, and no set beats the one in hand, so Direct Hit 0 is proven best (265 ms). If a front passes 150,000 entries, or the extensions pass 1,000,000 in all, the branch and bound runs instead, still with the set in hand and the reduced lists.
